bespoke_destination.not_live_default_reason: Gateway configuration defaults to DispatcherKind::Jenkins and the checked-in Helm deployment only sets OYA_JENKINS_DISPATCH_URL; no checked-in Helm default selects OYA_CI_DISPATCHER=controller or sets OYA_CI_CONTROLLER_URL.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: ADR-0363 and current gateway/Helm source show Jenkins as the active bridge; ADR-0513 accepts bespoke oya-ci as the destination.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Keep Jenkins bridge until ADR-0513 Phase 1 parallel-run/cutover gates pass; encode no-delete-now guard.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: ADR-0511 proposed Argo Workflows as the CI destination; ADR-0513 later accepted the bespoke Rust Prow-shaped oya-ci platform.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Treat ADR-0513 Accepted as controlling for this lane; preserve ADR-0511 only as historical/proposed evidence.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: Controller source and chart exist, but gateway defaults and Helm values still dispatch to Jenkins.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Do not claim custom CI live default until Helm and runtime cutover select controller and produce required statuses.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: ADR-0514 flags the bridge script execution path as PR-controllable even though the Jenkinsfile is trunk-sourced.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Controller Job must clone dev as trusted source and treat PR ref as data before bridge deletion.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: The gateway-dispatched Jenkins bridge posts GitHub status context oya-ci-gate, but dev branch protection requires cargo-fmt/cargo-check/cargo-clippy/cargo-nextest/cargo-deny/oya-verify and reported-status metadata does not list oya-ci-gate.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Treat oya-ci-gate as bridge dispatch evidence, not merge-readiness proof; controller cutover must reconcile the actual posted contexts with branch protection and producer metadata in one reviewed slice.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: dev branch protection requires six contexts; Jenkins reported-status metadata lists those six plus additional governance/review contexts; the gateway-dispatched bridge Jenkinsfile itself posts oya-ci-gate, a seventh bridge context that is not required or declared in reported metadata.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Cutover must reconcile required contexts, actual bridge/controller posted contexts, and status producer metadata in one reviewed slice.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: infra/ci/jenkins/reported-status-contexts.json describes GitHub status-check contexts via a Jenkins GitHub App and names producer infra/ci/Jenkinsfile + shared-library, but infra/ci/Jenkinsfile is absent while the checked active bridge path posts GitHub status from infra/ci/jenkins/Jenkinsfile-oya-ci-gate.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Treat reported-status metadata as drifted producer-contract evidence only; cutover must rename sink semantics to GitHub, point producers at existing files, and reconcile oya-ci-gate versus required contexts.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: G007 current-live path discusses GitHub PR webhook and GitHub Commit Status API, but infra/branch-protection/dev.json mirrors GitHub branch-protection REST API, .github/branch-protection.yaml says github.com/jason931225/oyatie is deployed, and scripts/branch-protection-apply.sh uses gh api for required_status_checks.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Preserve ADR-0363 nuance: GitHub is still the bootstrap branch-protection host while GitHub (interim) is the target; do not claim fully GitHub-hosted branch protection until host cutover evidence exists.

contradictions_and_resolution.conflict: root Jenkinsfile comments mention microservices/<ms>/ci/Jenkinsfile while the active gateway-dispatched bridge evidence is the JCasC-wired infra/ci/jenkins/Jenkinsfile-oya-ci-gate path.
contradictions_and_resolution.resolution: Treat the root Jenkinsfile as a stale Jenkins-surface hygiene item only; active-bridge claims must cite infra/ci/jenkins/Jenkinsfile-oya-ci-gate and JCasC.

branch_protection_host_drift.github_target_host_source: ADR-0363 says GitHub (interim) is target while GitHub remains bootstrap host until cutover

current_live_path.safe_answer_to_jenkinsfile_question: The infra/ci/jenkins/Jenkinsfile-oya-ci-gate bridge is source-wired through JCasC and gateway defaults. The root Jenkinsfile is a separate stale Jenkins-surface hygiene item; do not use it as proof of the gateway-dispatched active bridge.
current_live_path.status_context_reconciliation_note: The gateway-dispatched Jenkins bridge posts only the oya-ci-gate context; dev branch protection currently requires cargo-fmt, cargo-check, cargo-clippy, cargo-nextest, cargo-deny, and oya-verify; reported-status metadata covers those six plus additional governance/review contexts but does not declare oya-ci-gate. This is active migration debt, not proof that Jenkins is unused.

required_before_deletion: Gateway Helm values select OYA_CI_DISPATCHER=controller and set OYA_CI_CONTROLLER_URL for the deployed self-hosted path.
Controller creates per-PR K8s gate Jobs from trusted dev source while treating the PR ref as data.
Controller posts every required GitHub status context, or branch-protection required-context specs are updated with producers in the same reviewed cutover.
Bridge-only oya-ci-gate context is either promoted into the required-context contract with a producer declaration or replaced by controller-produced required contexts.
Parallel-run evidence shows Jenkins bridge and controller gate green on the same PR set without admin bypass.
A mutation test proves PR-sourced changes cannot weaken or bypass the controller gate command.
Structured failure summary is posted without kubectl exec or Jenkins console dependency.
reported-status metadata no longer names GitHub/Jenkins-App sink semantics or missing infra/ci/Jenkinsfile producers.
GitHub-bootstrap branch-protection apply surface is either retired after GitHub host cutover or explicitly reconciled with GitHub status sink semantics.
Status-context drift between infra/branch-protection/dev.json, .github/branch-protection.yaml, and producer metadata is reconciled.
Jenkins bridge deletion happens in the same reviewed cutover slice that proves the replacement and preserves rollback notes.
